definition: The term unlawful is a general description for conduct that is illegal or not authorized by law. The term is sometimes used in a more narrow sense; for instance, unlawful may refer only to conduct that is criminally universal life insurance / unlawful Dictionary compilation | 26 September 2026 punishable. At other times, unlawful may refer only to actions that violate statutory law (as opposed to actions that violate uncodified common law doctrines such as negligence). See: unlawful assembly
